acceptance: Open and in-progress task views are prominent; closed and verified work can be filtered.
Project switching immediately restores saved snapshot and view state.
Refresh fetches only missing committed events and updates changed snapshot.
Private data stays scoped to signed-in GitHub user; logout removes local cached data.
Responsive interactive dashboard is deployed and validated.
payload.description: Upgrade hosted DIP dashboard to intuitive CRM-like task workspace prioritizing open/in-progress tasks, closed/verified filtering and subdued activity. Persist account-scoped project snapshots locally and incrementally fetch only missing data. Preserve GitHub read-only permissions; support client-local organization and preferences.
payload.title: Redesign DIP workspace for daily task management and incremental project cache
